compiled_state.title: review-workflow.sh fails: agent_id must not be empty or 'unknown'
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Observed
Running `bash plugins/dso/scripts/review-workflow.sh` from within a sprint story branch commit workflow fails with:

RuntimeError: agent_id must not be empty or 'unknown'; got: 'unknown'

## Context
Occurred during sprint a03c-d55e-1393-4f27 S1 commit. The dispatch.py _load_agent_prompt receives agent_id='unknown'.

## Impact
Blocks automated code review via commit workflow. Workaround: dispatch code reviewer agent directly via Agent tool.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Stage changes to behavioral files
2. Run: bash plugins/dso/scripts/review-workflow.sh
